title: 第十二章 同学会
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“怪不得杨旭要对付我。”

叶凡眼中划过精光，“在他眼里，你就是他的财富密码，得到你，他就能拿到海外渠道，让陈家更进一步。”

“是的，同时这也是我们两家想要的，我们的长辈都希望我们能走在一起，这样才能加深合作。”陈若彤脸色难看，“所以叶凡，为了你的安全，你只能搬去我那住，这样，他至少不敢乱来。”

叶凡沉默。

他能看出陈若彤难处，这已不是个人问题，是两个家族，两个集团的利益蛋糕。

换成他是陈若彤，他也只有这方法。

“好吧，目前只能这样了，我回去收拾一下，这就搬。”

“嗯，我找人帮你。”

陈若彤应声，叫来何叔。

简单说几句，何叔就点头，开车送叶凡回家。

叶凡拿了几件衣服，再次上车。

半小时后，叶凡来到一处名为明月山庄的别墅区。

他知道，这里很有名，是泉城公认有钱人的聚集地。

何叔带他到了一处位于中央的三层别墅，一到这，两个中年妇人就走过来。

何叔道，“叶先生，这两位是陈总的佣人，这位姓黄，这位姓张，黄姐，张姐，这位是叶凡，是盛宝楼二级鉴定师，接下来他要在这住一段时间。”

“叶先生好。”

两个妇人鞠躬，叶凡点头，“黄姨好，张姨好。”

“叶先生，接下来我带您去二楼客房，您可以挑一个房间。”何叔又道。

“好。”叶凡应声，迈步上楼。

很快，他就在二楼选了一个朝阳客房，何叔把叶凡行李搬到房内。

“叶先生，这二楼的洗手间，浴室都在不远处，您可以轻松找到，一日三餐您也不用担心，佣人做好会通过座机通知您，当然，您要有别的需求，也可以通过座机告诉佣人。”

叶凡点头，“知道了，谢谢何叔。”

“叶先生客气。”

何叔说了句，转身离开。

叶凡把东西整理好，就陷入沉思。

“论势力，论资产，我现在都不是杨旭对手，我唯一的本钱，是系统和望气术。”

“而系统什么时候跳出来，我无法决定，我现在能掌控的，只有望气术。”

“嗯，那就全力修炼望气术，想必修炼到一定程度，系统自会出现变化。”

"No wonder Yang Xu wants to deal with me."

Ye Fan's eyes flashed with light, "In his eyes, you are the password to his wealth. If he gets you, he can get overseas channels and let the Chen family go further."

"Yes, this is also what our two families want. Our elders hope that we can get together so that we can deepen our cooperation." Chen Ruotong said with an ugly face, "So Ye Fan, for your safety, you can only move to my place. This way, at least he will not dare to mess around."

Ye Fan was silent.

He could see Chen Ruotong's difficulty. This was no longer a personal issue, but a cake of interests for two families and two groups.

If it were Chen Ruotong, he would only have this method.

"Okay, that's all for now. I'll go back and clean it up, and then we'll move."

"Well, I'll find someone to help you."

Chen Ruotong responded and called Uncle He.

After saying a few words, Uncle He nodded and drove Ye Fan home.

Ye Fan took some clothes and got in the car again.

Half an hour later, Ye Fan came to a villa area called Mingyue Villa.

He knew that this place was very famous and was recognized as a gathering place for wealthy people in Quancheng.

Uncle He took him to a three-story villa in the center. As soon as he arrived, two middle-aged women came over.

Uncle He said, "Mr. Ye, these two are Mr. Chen's servants. This one's surname is Huang, this one's surname is Zhang, Sister Huang, Sister Zhang, and this is Ye Fan, a second-level appraiser of Shengbao Building. He will live here for a while."

"Hello, Mr. Ye."

The two women bowed and Ye Fan nodded, "Hello Aunt Huang, hello Aunt Zhang."

"Mr. Ye, I will take you to the guest room on the second floor. You can choose a room." Uncle He said again.

"Okay." Ye Fan responded and stepped upstairs.

Soon, he chose a Chaoyang guest room on the second floor, and Uncle He moved Ye Fan's luggage into the room.

"Mr. Ye, the restrooms and bathrooms on the second floor are not far away. You can find them easily. You don't have to worry about three meals a day. The servant will notify you through the landline when it is ready. Of course, if you have other needs, you can also tell the servant through the landline."

Ye Fan nodded, "I understand, thank you, Uncle He."

"Mr. Ye, you're welcome."

Uncle He said something, turned and left.

Ye Fan put things in order and fell into deep thought.

"In terms of power and assets, I am no match for Yang Xu now. My only assets are the system and Qi-gazing technique."

"And when the system will jump out, I can't decide. All I can control now is the qi-watching technique."

"Well, then go all out to practice the Qi Watching Technique. I believe that after you practice to a certain level, the system will automatically change."
